<article class="card" data-tone="past" id="verbs-past">
<header class="card-head">
<div class="card-title">
<h3>
<span lang="sr">
Perfekat
</span>
<em>
Past
</em>
</h3>
</div>
</header>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Meaning
</h4>
<p class="verb-prose">
The everyday past: what happened or how things were.
</p>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Formula
</h4>
<p class="verb-formula">
<a href="#aux-biti-short">
<span lang="sr">
biti (sam)
</span>
</a>
<span class="chart-sep">
+
</span>
<span class="verb-term">
past participle
</span>
</p>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Participle
</h4>
<div class="verb-bands">
<div class="gender-band">
<h5 class="chart-label">
Singular
</h5>
<div class="gender-run">
<span class="ending-unit">
<span class="eu-gender" data-gender="m">
M
</span>
<span class="eu-form">
<span lang="sr">
-o
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span class="ending-unit">
<span class="eu-gender" data-gender="n">
N
</span>
<span class="eu-form">
<span lang="sr">
-lo
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span class="ending-unit">
<span class="eu-gender" data-gender="f">
F
</span>
<span class="eu-form">
<span lang="sr">
-la
</span>
</span>
</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="gender-band">
<h5 class="chart-label">
Plural
</h5>
<div class="gender-run">
<span class="ending-unit">
<span class="eu-gender" data-gender="m">
M
</span>
<span class="eu-form">
<span lang="sr">
-li
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span class="ending-unit">
<span class="eu-gender" data-gender="n">
N
</span>
<span class="eu-form">
<span lang="sr">
-la
</span>
</span>
</span>
<span class="ending-unit">

</span>

-le
</span>

M plural also covers mixed groups.
</p>

<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Placement
</h4>
<div class="card-items">
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Gledao si film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
You watched a film.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Ona je gledala film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
She watched a film.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Nismo gledali film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
We did not watch a film.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Juče su gledali film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
Yesterday they watched a film.
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<article class="card" data-tone="future" id="verbs-future">

Oni će raditi.

They will work.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">

Radićeš.
</div>

</div>

-ći verbs

<article class="card" data-tone="future">
<header class="card-head">
<div class="card-title">
<h3>
<span lang="sr">
Futur II
</span>
<em>
Future II
</em>
</h3>
</div>
</header>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Meaning
</h4>
<p class="verb-prose">
The future in
<i lang="sr">
kad
</i>
(when),
<i lang="sr">
ako
</i>
(if),
<i lang="sr">
čim
</i>
(as soon as) clauses.
</p>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Formula
</h4>
<p class="verb-formula">
<a href="#aux-biti-perfective">
<span lang="sr">
biti (budem)
</span>
</a>
<span class="chart-sep">
+
</span>
<span class="verb-term">
past participle
</span>
</p>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Examples
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="note" class="tip-chip" data-verb-note="fut2" type="button">
?
</button>
</h4>
<div class="card-items">
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Kad budem imao vremena, doći ću.
</div>
<div class="tr">
When I have time, I will come.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Ako budeš imala vremena, dođi.
</div>
<div class="tr">
If you have time, come.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Čim budemo završili posao, javićemo se.
</div>
<div class="tr">
As soon as we finish the work, we will get in touch.
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</article>
<article class="card" data-tone="potencijal" id="verbs-conditional">

</h4>
<p class="verb-prose">

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>
<div class="tr">

</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">

</div>
<div class="tr">
We would not go.
</div>
</div>

<article class="card verb-clitic" data-tone="clitic" id="verbs-clitics">
<header class="card-head">

<span lang="sr">
se

</h3>
</div>

<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Examples
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="note" class="tip-chip" data-verb-note="se" type="button">
?

<div class="card-item">

<mark>
se
</mark>
.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I take a walk.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Ja
<mark>
sam se
</mark>
šetao.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I took a walk.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Nisam
<mark>
se
</mark>
šetao.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I did not take a walk.
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</article>
### popover [data-verb-note]|[["data-verb-note","ati"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
<i lang="sr">
-ati
</i>
: check the present
</h4>
<p>
The infinitive ending alone does not pick the present pattern. Use the 1sg form beside each verb.
</p>
</article>
### popover [data-verb-note]|[["data-verb-note","fut2"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
Subordinate clauses
</h4>
<p>
The main clause often uses Futur I, but other forms are possible. A perfective verb in the subordinate clause can use its present form instead of Futur II.
</p>
</article>
### popover [data-verb-note]|[["data-verb-note","se"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
Second position
</h4>
<p>
Clitics, the short unstressed words, normally stand as one group after the first word or phrase of their clause. Other clitics may come before
<i lang="sr">
se
</i>
. A clause never opens with
<i lang="sr">
se
</i>
.
</p>
</article>
